SRC-018:R001.text: CORE-001: Preserve caller-supplied completed_roots and unresolved_roots when plain-list _set_cache publishes a partial scan; use ScanOutcome provenance when supplied; keep legacy no-provenance incomplete preservation; apply one root authority consistently to projects, linked worktrees, watcher/index/cache reconciliation, and the real BackgroundScanner callback.
